Job Title: Senior Mechanical BIM Engineer
Company: Oasis Build Contracting LLC – Dubai, UAE
Employment type: Full-time

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Mechanical BIM Engineer to lead the mechanical BIM workstream on a large hospitality project and coordinate a team of modelers.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
- Minimum 8 years of experience in MEP BIM, of which at least 3 years in a coordination or lead role.
- Expert in Revit MEP and Navisworks Manage (clash detection and clash reporting).
- Experience producing HVAC, plumbing and fire fighting shop drawings and combined services drawings.
- Experience with BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud.
- Ability to lead coordination meetings with consultants and subcontractors.

Preferred
- Dynamo scripting.
- ISO 19650 knowledge.
- UAE project experience.

expected.notes: Candidate has ~4.8y vs required minimum 8 -> years knockout. Tool/skill match is good (Revit, Navisworks, clash detection, shop drawings, ducts) but no coordination/lead experience, Dynamo or ISO 19650, so fit is possible rather than strong.

Senior HVAC Design Engineer – Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Al Fanar Engineering Consultants (MEP consultancy)

Responsibilities
• HVAC design from concept to IFC for healthcare, commercial and residential projects.
• Cooling load calculations, chilled water and VRF system design, duct and pipe sizing.
• Prepare specifications, BOQs and design reports; review contractor submittals.
• Coordinate with BIM team and other disciplines.

Requirements
• B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.
• 7+ years of HVAC design experience with a consultancy.
• Valid Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) Professional Engineer accreditation is MANDATORY at the time of application.
• Proficiency in HAP (or Trace 700), AutoCAD and Revit MEP.
• Strong knowledge of ASHRAE, SMACNA and the Saudi Building Code (SBC 501).

Preferred
• Healthcare design experience.
• Smoke control / stair pressurization design.

expected.notes: Candidate matches the technical requirements very well (8.8y consultancy HVAC design, HAP, chilled water, VRF, Revit, hospital and smoke control experience) but holds no SCE accreditation (Egypt-only, Engineers Syndicate). Mandatory SCE -> cert knockout.

MEP Project Manager
Location: New Administrative Capital, Egypt
Company: Delta Tower Developments (main contractor)

Job Purpose
Manage the complete MEP scope of a high-rise mixed-use development from mobilisation to handover.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan and control MEP works, budgets and subcontractors.
- Prepare and monitor MEP programmes in Primavera P6.
- Coordinate with consultant, client and authorities.
- Lead testing and commissioning and handover.

Qualifications
- B.Sc. Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
- Minimum 10 years of MEP experience including at least 4 years as MEP Project Manager.
- PMP certification (PMI) is mandatory.
- Strong cost control and contract administration skills.
- Member of the Egyptian Engineers Syndicate.

Nice to have
- High-rise experience.
- FIDIC knowledge.

expected.notes: Candidate is a strong fit on experience (12.4y, ~6.9y as MEP PM in Egypt, Primavera, cost control, T&C, Syndicate member) but has only a PMP preparation course, exam not taken. Mandatory PMP -> cert knockout. A keyword ATS may wrongly pass him because 'PMP' appears.

* B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.

expected.notes: All must-haves met: 8.7y UAE fire protection, NFPA 13/14/20/2001, Elite Fire/PIPENET, DCD approvals; also has all preferred items (UAE Civil Defence approval, Revit, foam).
